sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully targets the ship, records the required MCR bollard rotational-speed quantity in rev/min, and enforces an exhaustive known/unknown selection. The unknown branch requires the Table 6-9 lookup flag, a linked lookup case, the exact controlled table reference, and lookup-selection evidence on the lookup case.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add the declared nltl:tableLookupApplied boolean constraint to the unknown-speed lookup case, requiring exactly one value and sh:hasValue true, alongside the Table 6-9 reference and lookup-selection evidence. This is needed to encode that n is actually attributed using the cited table rather than merely attaching a referenced/evidenced lookup-case node.
